name: CaveGals
source: Set in the Stone Age. A shut-in Cave Woman named Smoke meets a strange woman (with glasses) who supposedly came from the mystical land called "Future." Together, they set out to explore the island, meet wacky characters, find hidden truths, and maybe find love?
